tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad par lhan thabs nag po 'gro shes su bkod pa bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa'i lhan thabs nag po 'gro shes bklag chog tu 'god par bya ba la rje btsun bla ma mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i dbang phyug gi zhabs kyi pad+mo la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ blo tshan khrag 'thung dgyes rnams gsal mdzad cing*// sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan zlos gar gyis// rnam gsum pho nya'i drwa ba rgya mtsho'i sprin// spro dang sdud mdzad khyod kyi thugs rjes skyongs//

'dir mkha' spyod don du gnyer ba'i gang zag gis bsnyen pa'i kha bskong ba dang*/ rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib sbyong ba dang*/ sngags kyi nus mthu 'byin pa dang*/ mkha' spyod dngos grub skye ba 'di nyid la thob pa'i phyir sbyin sreg gi cho ga rgyas bsdus gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i sa phyogs kyi dbang du byas nas zhes gsungs pas sngar sa chog tshul bzhin byas pa'i lha khang dang*/ sgrub gnas rnying par sa chog sogs mi dgos kyang*/ de ltar ma yin pa'i sar sbyin sreg byed na sa chog byas pa 'jam zhing shis pas de la sa brtag slang*/ sbyangs/ bzung gi cho ga rgyas pa ma 'grub kyang phyag len la gang du bya ba'i sa gzhi der bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pas cha gsum gtor ma dang*/ gzhi bdag gtor ma gang rung ngam mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sgrub mchod ltar gtang la sa gzhi slong ba'i phrin las bcol/ bgegs bskrad byed/ de nas sa lha'i cho ga ni/ thab stegs bya ba'i sa gzhi'i dbus su dri bzang gi chu 'byor na ba byung lnga dang bcas pa'i chag chag dang thig le byas pa'i steng ngam spro na mañji maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa'i steng du 'bras nas gro gang rung gi tshom bu bkod pa'i mdun du gtor ma bzlum po pad 'dab bzhi pa dang*/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bcas bshams la/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i srin lag g.yas pa'i rtsa bar ham̐ yig 'bar bas mtshan par gyur par bsams/ srin lag de nyid sa la bsnun pa'i steng ka bya zhing ngag tu/ ham̐ ham̐ ham̐ zhes brjod pas sa gzhi g.yos pa'i rkyen gyis tshom bu'i steng du sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhi ba'i nyams can rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis bkang ba thugs khar bsnams pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis las ci bgyi bka' stsal du gsol zhes gsungs bzhin mdun du mngon gsum du gsal bar gyur

par bsams/ de nas mchod pa la dmigs te/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswā bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dang shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur par bsams la so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ gis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ pri thi bī de wi gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dbul/ oṃ pri thi bī de wi gṛh+ṇe daṃ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas zhabs bsil/ de nas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha we/ badz+ra dharmā hṛ da ya ni san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ de nas gtor ma chu gtsang gis sbyangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ pri thi bī de wi na maḥ

sarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+ya/ sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul la spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyis// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seṅge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pa'i mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir sa'i phyogs 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag sogs dngos grub kyi mchog blang bar 'tshal na sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar bgyis shig ces gnang ba sbyin par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ pri thi bī de wi gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ pri thi bī de wi gṛh+ṇe daṃ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes chu gnyis phul/ lag pa rdo rje dang bcas pa sa la reg te/ oṃ pri thi bī de wi badz+ra muḥ sa'i lha mo sa gzhi de nyid du thim pas rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur par bsams la/ sa'i lha mo'i sgos mchod dang*/ me tog tshom bu sogs bsal la gnas khang byi dor dang*/ rten dang mchod pa'i yo byad ji ltar 'os pa bshams/ kha shar du phyogs par stan nang tshangs can gyi mdun du lcog rtse sogs kyi khar/ rdor dril gyi bar du gzar bu gnyis kha sprad nas ma bral bar bzhag g.yas su ḍā ma ru dang me tog phor pa/

bsang chu'i dung phor dri bzang po'i chu/ ku sha'i thor yab dang bcas pa/ g.yon du nang mchod cog rtse'i mdun du me yol 'jim pa la dkar zhal byugs pa la wam̐ yig gangs ri chu rgyun sogs bris pa bzhag mdun du zhi ba'i thab stegs zlum po brus pa brtsigs pa gang 'thad mthong brgyud kyi phyag len ltar zhes gsungs pas/ deng sang thab brus pa dang brtsigs pa sogs phyag len la cher mi mdzad cing las bzhi gang byed kyang thab stegs stegs bu gru bzhi pa dpangs dang rgya che chung la tshad nges pa cher med kyang bskyed chog ltar gyi thab dkyil bri ba la gzhi lhag par 'thas shing ngos snyoms pa'i zhal ba byas par dkar rtsis legs par byugs/ de steng thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par gdab/ de'i dbus nas khru phyed dam mtho gang tshad kyi zlum skor dang*/ de'i phyi rol du sor bzhi pa gnyis skor ba'i zlum skor gsum gyi nang ma thab nang dang*/ de'i phyi kha khyer/ de'i phyi mu ran/ de'i phyi sor bzhi'i tshad kyi thab stegs gru bzhi'i thig spyi dang mthun par btab/ zlum skor dang po dang tshang thig phrad pa nas dbus kyi bar gyi srad bu des zlum skor dang po'i shar gyi g.yas g.yon gang slebs su rtags bya/ nub tu yang snga ma bzhin gyi rtags byas/ shar nub kyi tshangs thig zlum skor phrad mtshams nas g.yas g.yon gyi rtags bzhi byas pas/ de'i steng thig btab pas chos 'byung nyis brtsegs 'byung*/ de la rdul mtshon nam chu mtshon gyi chos 'byung nyis brtsegs dmar po/ bcad dkar po/ dbus su nyi gdan dmar ser la rdo rje dmar po sgang po'am yang na tshom bu dmar po bya/ thab nang*/ kha khyer mu ran gyi gzhi dkar po la mdangs mdzes mtshon dang bcad dmar skya kha khyer la gri gug gi phreng ba dang*/ mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas skor ba/ chos 'byung gi zur drug zlum bskor gyi phyi/ stegs bu gru bzhi'i thig gi nang gi mtshams bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bcas legs par bris/

kha khyer gyi steng tsam du bud shing ngam srog chags med pa'i lci ba skam pos khru phyed tsam zlum por brtsigs pa'i nang gi shar lhor zan gyi ting lo'i me tshangs bshams/ rang gi g.yas phyogs su stegs gtsang ma'i khar bsreg rdzas yam shing sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad mthe bong las mi sbom zhing*/ mthe'u chung las mi phra ba rtsa rtse mar dang bu ram gyis byugs pa/ mar/ til nag zas mchog ka ra/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsi/ ra'i 'o ma/ zho/ mar khu bcas la rtsam pa btab pa'i phye mar dang yang na ril bu bya/ 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ dur ba/ ku sha chang la bdud rtsi'i ril bu btab pa/ ba glang dmar po/ gi sha dum bu mar la rtsos pas byed/ la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa rnams bzhag rang gi g.yon phyogs su stegs gtsang ma'i khar 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis sam mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bcas gsum dang*/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga tshar gnyis bshams/ thab kyi mthar 'grem rgyu'i ku sha'i chun po brgyad/ me spar ba'i lce mde/ me gso ba'i bud shing skam po/ rlung g.yab dang bcas pa sogs yo byad thams cad ma tshang ba med par bshams/ de yang bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags par 'dod na yar ngo*/ bar bcad 'joms par 'dod na mar ngo ste tshes bcu gnyis gang rung gi dus khyad par can nam/ dus gang yang rung ba'i snga dro'am/ dgong mo'i cha la stan bde ba la bzang po'i 'dug stangs zhes rgyal po rol ba'i stabs sam zhi ba'i skyil krung bcas/ chas gos dkar po'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'am bsdu na stan dkar gyi steng du dar ras dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs tshul pang khebs byas la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bid+yā rā dzaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa tshar gsum gyis srung 'khor gsal btab nas/

skyabs 'gro nas bsam mi khyab kyi thun bsdu ba'i bar bdag bskyed grub rjes nang mchod gsar pa yin na 'dir byin brlabs byas la de nas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis 'thor zhing*/ bsang chu sgrub pa ni/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswā bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las shaṃ las byung ba'i dung phor dri ma med pa'i nang du/ hūm̐ las bsang chu rdzas rnams kyi bgegs dang ma dag pa sel pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa nyer gcig gam bdun gyis byin gyis rlabs/ 'di man gyi bsang ba rnams la bsang chu kho nas 'thor ba yin/ mchod pa rnams/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+na pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyi bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhāḥsarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dha3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ rnams so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis rlabs/

nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dpral bar bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ ces pas mang por spel/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha we/ badz+ra dharmā hri da ya ni/ san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa tshar gsum gyis rol chen ḍā dril dang bcas pas byin gyis rlobs/ bsregs rdzas rnams kyang*/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pa la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ las bsregs rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa las so so sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ā swā hā/ oṃ shrī swā hā/ oṃ dz+riṃ swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ tshar res byin gyis rlabs/ spros pa la dga' na/ oṃ bo dhi brik+ṣa ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba saṃ po de swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā be ga ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ba la ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ra ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ ma da na pañca a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ba la pañca a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes rdzas sngags tshar re brjod/ yang thab la dmigs te/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bh+wa wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/

gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po rgyar khru gang pa/ dpangs su khru phyed pa/ kha khyer la gri gug gi phreng ba dang*/ mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i nang du/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi zur rnams su zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis gang bar gyur/ de nas me sgrub pa ni/ bram ze rgyun bzhag gi mar me 'di bod du mi 'byor bas/ thab kyi me rgyun ma chad pa'i mes tshab bya ba phyag len no// las sngar gyi lce mde spor la/ lag pa gnyis kyis bzung ste/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dhā ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzla zhing thab la g.yon nas lan gsum skor zhing me tshang du bcug oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod/ me gso ba'i rtswa skam cung zad bzhag cing*/ rlung g.yab cung zad g.yab/ yang*/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes mar blugs gzar gsum blug ste me gso/ de nas 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me de nyid/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las me 'bar ba'i dbus su ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ g.yas kyi dang pos mchog sbyin/ gnyis pas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gyi dang pos dbyug gu rtse gsum pa/ gnyis pas bdud rtsis gang ba'i ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ tshangs pa'i skud pas mdzes par byas pa/ khri snyan sa le'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs dang*/ dar dmar po'i shams thabs can/ sku las mdangs dang 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha ye shes pa drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ lag pa g.yas pas dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ oṃ/ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsregs blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ e h+ye hi ma hā bhu ta de wa ri ṣi dwi dzaḥs twa ma ghi hi twa/ ma hā asmin+san+ni hi to bha wa/ ag+ne ye e h+ye hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ gnyis su med par thim par gyur par bsams/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ ku sha/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dhar+m+maḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa rtse ma nyams pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin// 'dis bdag la bgegs med par mdzod cig /ma ma shān+tiṃ kurban swā hā/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad du byas pa phyogs g.yon bskor dang*/ mtshams g.yas bskor gyis bkram/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i lce hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐ dang*/ dgang blugs kyi kha la yang ram̐ gyis mtshan par gyur par bsams la/ gzar bu gnyis pus mo gnyis kyi bar du chud par byas te byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung la/ oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing mar blugs gzar lan bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar te thab la g.yon du skor zhing me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsams la/ oṃ ag+ne ye a dī bya dī bya/ a bhi ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya bha ha na ye bdag gis mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ de ltar byon zan lan gsum phul nas/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra pād+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wa ra dhu pe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wa ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wa ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wa ra nai wi d+ye pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/

oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis nang mchod phul nas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par bstod// skabs 'dir me pra brtags la/ ngan na bsang chu gtor zhing sum+bha ni brjod pas bsrung*/ de nas bsreg rdzas kyi snod lag pa g.yon pas bzung*/ g.yas pa'i theb srin gyis blangs la g.yon pa'i 'og nas bskor zhing*/ 'bul ba'i tshe mchog sbyin phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ ag+ne ye lha sngags bo dhi brik+ṣa ye/ rdzas sngags/ bdag gi sdig sgrib bar chad sngags kyi nyes pa las sngags thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ bo dhi brik+ṣa ye swā hā/ zhes rdzas sngags rkyang pa bdun sogs ci rigs pas dbul/ de bzhin du sku sha'i bar thams cad la thog mtha' bar gsum du sngags/ lha sngags rdzas sngags las sngags gsum ka sbrel ba dang*/ gzhan rdzas sngags rkyang pas bdun sogs grangs mnyam par phul te/ rdzas sngags ni oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā/ mar dang*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ til dang*/ oṃ sarba saṃ bo de swā hā/ zas mchog oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye swā hā/ so ba/ oṃ ma hā be ga ye swā hā/ nas dang*/ oṃ ma hā ba la ye swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ra ye swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swā hā/ dur ba/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swā hā/ ku sha/ oṃ ma da na pañca a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ chang dang*/ oṃ ba la pañca a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ ba glang gi sha dum gyi sngags so// yang*/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pā ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/

oṃ a g+ne ye sa pa ri wa ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wa ra dhu pe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wa ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha ye sā hā/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra nai wi d+ye pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pā ri wa ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes phyi mchod phul/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul nas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par bstod// oṃ ag+ne ye dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes mar blugs gzar gang phul ba'i rkyen gyis me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha bskyed pa ni/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swā bhā shud+dho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi nang du pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar g.yon bskor gyi oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng kha dog dmar pos bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yig 'bru rnams la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po mgo bo rgyab tu bltab nas bsnan pa/

sku mdog dmar po skal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur bas sku sked yan chad khebs pa/ lang tsho dar la bab cing 'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa/ bde ba skyed pa'i nyams can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i steng 'og phyogs mtshams mtha' skor du rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi bskor bar gyur par bsams la/ de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya smin mtshams su g.yon bskor du lan gsum bskor zhing ngag tu/ phaiṃ/ rang gi thugs kha'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim/ pad kor gyi mthar 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha pā dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra nai wi d+ye pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pradz+nya pā ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha we/ badz+ra dharmā hri da ya ni san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis nang mchod phul la rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas gtor ma rnams/ nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+na pā ya gṛh+na pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes pa phyag rgya bcas pas lan gsum brjod cing byin gyis rlabs la/

snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes go cha'i sngags rkyang pa tshar gsum brjod cing gsal gdab/ yang mar blugs gzar gang dbul zhing*/ oṃ ag+ne ye dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam pa las rang gzugs su byon par gyur par bsams/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i lce hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐ dang*/ dgang blugs kyi kha la ram̐ gyis mtshan par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar te thab la g.yon du bskor zhing*/ me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsams la/ oṃ ag+ne ye a dī bya dī bya/ a bhi ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya bha ha na ye bdag gis mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ de ltar gshegs skyems mar bdun tshan gsum phul nas/ sreg rdzas lhag ma rnams/ oṃ ag+ne ye bod+dhi brik+ṣa ye bdag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad gsang sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ ag+ne ye lha sngags/ bod+dhi brik+ṣa ye sogs rdzas sngags/ bdag gi sdig sgrib sogs las sngags tshar gcig gis sna grangs/ gzhan rdzas sngags rkyang pa grangs bdun nam bcu gcig sogs ci rigs phul te/ rdzas sngags/ oṃ bo d+dhi brik+ṣa ye swā hā/ yam shing*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ mar dang*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ til dang*/ oṃ sarba saṃ po de swā hā/ zas mchog dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye swā hā/ so ba/ oṃ ma hā be ga ye swā hā/

nas/ oṃ ma hā ba la ye swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ra ye swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swā hā/ dur ba/ oṃ a pra tī ha ta badz+ra ye swā hā/ ku sha/ oṃ ma da na pañca a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ chang dang*/ oṃ ba la pañca a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ ba glang gi sha dum gyi sngags so// oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra dhu pe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hūm̐/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra ghan+dhe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra nai wi d+ye pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes phyi mchod phul/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis nang mchod phul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par bstod// zhes pas bstod/ gtor ma sngar byin gyis rlabs pa de nyid dran pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yeḥsarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i mam ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ne daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ zhes lan lnga'am gsum gyis phul/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ pūṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis nang mchod phul/ me de bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// me lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/

dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba// dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /

ces 'phrin las bcol/ oṃ shri badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka te no pa tiṣ+ṭha ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra ya ts+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wan badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñca/ badz+ra he ru ko bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod cing*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang du gyur pa thams cad dang*/ cho ga lhag pa dang chad par gyur pa dang*/ mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la skyon du gyur pa gang yin pa de thams cad bzod par mdzad de lhag chad kha skong bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lhag chad kha bskang*/ me lha spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya phyir skyed cing*/ oṃ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// bsgrubs kyi bzhud cig byin za khyod// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrub// oṃ ag+ne ye badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ thal ba sngar bzhin blangs la/ dam tshig pa rang la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ zhes brjod cing gnas gsum bsrungs/ oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes brjod cing*/ srung 'khor gsal gdab la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+na gṛh+na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+na pā ya gṛh+na pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes sngags tshar gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas phyogs g.yon skor mtshams g.yas skor gyis bsrung ba bya/

las bsags pa don dang ldan pa'i phyir bsngo ba smon lam mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i bar rgyun gyi nyams len bzhin dang*/ phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi dpal mnga' ba sogs bkra shis brjod/ me tog gi char dbab/ sbyin sreg nyi ma sbrel nas byed na thal ba rnams dkrugs brdal du ma song ba'i sngar gyi thal ba de nan pa byas pa'i khar lci bas brtsigs te/ cho ga rnams ni gong ji lta bar mdzad/ grol ba'i nyin tshogs 'khor mdzad pa'i tshogs rdzas rnams phyag len bzhin bshams nas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha'i gtor 'bul tshar ma thag gtor ma byin rlabs ltar byin gyis brlab nas/ sngags 'bul yan chad dkyus bzhin mdzad/ dam tshig spel ba dang tshogs la longs spyod pa ni 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i dam tshig pa rang la bsdus nas gnas gsum bsrungs/ go cha'i lha sngags dang srung sngags brjod pa yan grub nas mdzad/ tshogs lhag nas bkra shis kyi bar rjes chog ma gtogs tshes bcu'i mchod pa ltar mdzad pas 'grub cing*/ thab shul chu dang 'o mas bkru zhing*/ thal ba rnams mi phyugs mang pos 'thung ba'i chu bo'am/ ri thon po'i rtser gdan drangs par bya'o// de ltar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi yi ge rje sa chen yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i yig rnying dang*/ kun mkhyen go bo rin po ches mdzad pa dang*/ gtso bo rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i yi ge gzhir bzhag der mi gsal ba rnams bde kye'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg nas kha 'gong bar gsungs pa bzhin kha bskangs/ bla ma yab sras kyi gsung rgyun dang phyag len gyi rim pas go bde bar byas don la rang bzo'i dri mas ma slad par sbyar ba 'di ni/ tshul 'di la mos pa'i don gnyer gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams kyi bya bral ba dbang phyug rab brtan gyis yul dbus kyi sa'i sman ljongs/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i sras kyi mthu bo rdo rje btsun mo nyid kyis ring nas bskyangs pa'i gnyan ston mchog gi sprul pa'i zlos gar rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa gzhon nu blo gros kyis zhal snga nas kyi 'debs par mdzad pa'i bkra shis dang dge mtshan du mas phyug pa'i chos sde/

snyan brgyud zab mo'i chos sgra rgyun mi chad par sgrog pa'i gnas/ rje btsun de nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs shing gdan chags pa'i gzim chung nyid du sbyar ba'o// 'dis kyang slob bshad zab mo'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig ces pa'i bka' rtsom ji lta bar las dang po pa rnams 'jug bde zhing cho ga mi 'khrug pa dang*/ dpe mang du tshol mi dgos par phan khyad kyi lhag bsam dang*/ khyad par gtsang stod sman thang gi lcam yum blo gsal kun dga' chos kyi sgron ma mkha' spyod ljags bsnyen sbyin sreg gnang dus kyi gzigs dper klag chog nag po 'gro shes kho nar bkod pa 'di ni dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs rmor chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos mchod pa'i bka' 'bangs lha rigs 'a zhwa'i rigs kyi rnal 'byor pa slob bshad 'dzin pa ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis mdar stod grangs chen rdo rje'i pho brang du sgrigs pa'i yi ge pa ni rig pa 'dzin pa rnam rgyal 'gyur med kyis dad brtson spro ba'i sgo nas legs par grub pa'o// dge'o// //par rtsa bal yul nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las spel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
